subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) The merchant sold him to a rich man to another country. (b) To escape torture, one day he fled from his master's house. (c) Once there lived a young man named Androcles. (d) Unfortunately he was caught by a salve merchant. (e) He took shelter in a cave. (f) He used to inflict heavy torture on him. (g) It was unbearable for him. (h) The man was very rude and cruel.  Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
